$about: Silence 'Find your pitch' settings, one source of truth for the website (src/audio/yourSound.js imports this file) and the iOS app (bundled as a resource, decoded at startup in ios/Silence/PitchSpec.swift). Change a number here and both change; the 'Silence sounds' check tests both. Hz are frequencies, dB are dBFS (0 = full scale): the comparison sound always starts at levelStartDb and can never go above levelMaxDb. ladderHz and refineStepsSemitones are for the step-by-step guide (part 2). hissBandwidthOctaves is how wide the hiss is (one-third octave).
